span.normalized: For the year ended December 31, 2024, four purchasers each accounted for more than 10% of the Company’s revenue: Vitol (17%), Enterprise (15%), Shell (13%) and DK Trading & Supply LLC (“DK”) (11%). For the year ended December 31, 2023, four purchasers each accounted for more than 10% of the Company’s revenue: Vitol (22%), DK (18%), Shell (14%) and Enterprise (13%). The Company does not require collateral and does not believe the loss of any single purchaser would materially impact its operating results, as crude oil and natural gas are fungible products with well-established markets and numerous purchasers.
